# Remora

> Remora is a menu bar inbox for your Mac: code reviews, merge requests, Slack mentions and Linear issues, sorted by what you have to do. On-device, no account, only the tools you allow.

Remora is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) macOS menu bar app. It groups items by what you have to do
(To reply, To review, To fix, Ready to merge, To do, Reminders, To read, Waiting on others), runs its sorting and
ranking on the device, and only talks to the tools the user or their organization allows. A Windows version is in
progress. French pages: https://triage.iscor.me/fr/.

## Pages

- [Remora — Menu bar inbox for GitHub, GitLab, Slack and Linear](https://triage.iscor.me/en/): Code reviews, merge requests, Slack mentions and Linear issues in one Mac menu bar inbox, sorted by what to do. Free, open source, on-device, no account.
- [Features — Remora, the menu bar inbox for developers](https://triage.iscor.me/en/features): Verbs instead of apps, Done and Pin, snooze with a reason, reminders dragged from the menu bar, review prep and sessions, a waiting assistant. All of Remora.
- [Privacy & compliance — Remora sends nothing but to your tools](https://triage.iscor.me/en/privacy): No server, no account, no telemetry: Remora talks only to the tools you allow, with AI off by default and a policy IT can lock with MDM. Every data flow.
